name: wazync
description: Save documents shared in WhatsApp groups into your folders, on request. Read and save only: it cannot send messages or files.

start_with_windows.title: Start with Windows
start_with_windows.description: Keep receiving WhatsApp messages after you sign in to Windows, even when Claude Desktop is closed.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check that WhatsApp is linked, connected and receiving messages

tools.name: link_whatsapp
tools.description: Show a QR code to link WhatsApp from your phone

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: Find chats and groups by name

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Read messages filtered by chat, sender, text or date

tools.name: get_message_context
tools.description: Show the messages around one message

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Find people by name or number

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List shared files with name, sender and whether already saved

tools.name: save_media
tools.description: Save a shared file into a folder, never overwriting or saving twice

tools.name: rename_saved_file
tools.description: Rename a file Wazync saved, never overwriting
